scope: selected growing containers, whole-input reads and the new accounting path

observations.result: native directory visitor retains aggregate counters and one key; file bodies are never opened by this implementation
4096 fixed slots and per-observation fixed-size reads; exhaustion is explicit and does not reset committed charges
retained peers stop at 256; the remaining readAll is guarded by a 2049-byte socket read buffer and request length check
grant encoding checks at most 16 shares before growing its name set
parser limits depth to 16, total nodes to 4096, object fields to 32 and array elements to 100
interrupted task recovery materializes only a LIMIT 100 page
received text page indexes remain under the existing 8 MiB protocol and shared-credit contract
version container holds three parts from a string capped at 32 characters

openFindings.result: QFileDialog::getOpenFileNames materializes all selected names before the application regains control; this review does not grant bounded-memory or full native-picker qualification for arbitrarily large direct selections
